title: Atomic Design
about: Brad Frost's five stages. Atoms, molecules and organisms are components, a template is a screen, and a page is a template tested with real content, which is what CIVIC's persona runs already are, so pages are not a tier. Templates hold screens by this profile's own rule; the owners place each component.

tiers.title: atom
tiers.description: A basic element that can't be broken down further and stay useful, such as a label, an input or a button.

tiers.title: molecule
tiers.description: A small group of atoms working as one unit, such as a search field with its label and button.

tiers.title: organism
tiers.description: A distinct section of an interface made of molecules, atoms or other organisms, such as a header or a product grid.

tiers.title: template
tiers.description: A screen's layout: the components it places, before real content fills it.
